_comment: Benchmark channel sources for Securesein. These are mostly not RSS feeds — benchmark results live in datasets, git repos and APIs, and should be ingested as structured data rather than scraped from leaderboard HTML. Sources with role=measurement feed the benchmarks collection; role=finding sources feed roundup context and contradiction detection only, and can never write a measurement record.

sources.license: CC-BY — attribution required in the rendered table
sources.note: Build this adapter first and completely. Independent evaluations with documented conditions (chat/instruct variants, API-default temperature, zero-shot CoT, empty system prompt), covering 50+ benchmarks including FrontierMath, GPQA Diamond, SWE-bench Verified, ARC-AGI-2, Terminal-Bench, HLE and Aider Polyglot. Two bases: internal runs and external runs — keep them distinguishable in the evaluator field.
Fallback if the Airtable-backed client library is unavailable or rate-limited. Bulk ZIP download, same data, without entity relationships.

Contamination-limited benchmark with monthly question refreshes and objective ground truth (no LLM judge). Read results from the repo rather than the leaderboard page. Record the question-set month in conditions.notes — scores across different months are not comparable.
Signals a new question set, which invalidates cross-month comparisons. A release here is a valid roundup trigger.
